host.description: A domain name of its own for the repository, such as docker.example.com; it must point to this server

path.description: With PATH routing, the first path segment that leads to the repository on the domain; the repository name when left out

routing.description: ROOT serves the repository at the top of the domain, which then belongs to it alone; PATH shares the domain between repositories, each under its own path segment

post.summary: Create security privileges repository content selector

put.summary: Update security privileges repository content selector
